title: Glossaries and QE quality reports
summary: Glossaries beside term bases and style guides, MQM quality reports across Translate Video, Translate Photo and Playground, Brand Kit as its own page, multi-file Playground translation and versioned prompts.

items.title: Glossaries.
items.body: A new **Glossaries** tab beside term bases and style guides holds names to keep verbatim and fixed wordings. Each entry has one wording per language and can be marked do-not-translate or case-sensitive.

children.body: Import and export CSV and Excel files, with a template to start from.
Link a glossary to memories from either side.
Where a glossary and a term base cover the same wording, the glossary wins.

items.title: Start a style guide without files.
items.body: Files are now optional, so a team that already knows its rules can create an empty guide and write them by hand.

items.title: A clearer term base table.
items.body: A collapsed concept shows its languages, its first term and a count per status, so you can tell a finished entry from unreviewed synonyms without opening it. Terms show the date and time they changed, and columns no longer shift when a row expands.

items.title: Import samples and templates.
items.body: The import dialogs offer TBX and TMX samples beside the spreadsheet templates, and a term base's import dialog has .xlsx and .csv templates to download.

items.title: A **Link to TM** button
items.body: in the toolbar of every term base, glossary and style guide page replaces the panel at the foot of the page.

items.title: MQM quality reports.
items.body: Run a QE report on a translation to get an overall score, errors by severity and category, adherence to your terminology, glossary and style guide, and an executive summary. QE reports need a VitraTM translation memory.

children.body: A segment explorer highlights each error and shows the corrected text.
Evaluate every segment, or only the ones not yet verified.
Apply the suggested fixes straight from the report.
Download the report as a PDF.

items.title: Available where you translate.
items.body: The Translate Video editor can run a QE report and shows a score on each card. Translate Photo image, DITA and document reviews have it too, and in Playground the QE report replaces the old AI QC report.

items.title: Brand Kit has its own page.
items.body: Your brand's colours, fonts, tone and logo now live under **Brand Kit** in the nav rail instead of inside Image Creator, so you no longer need Image Translation to reach them. Saved kits can be edited.

items.title: Translate several files at once.
items.body: Add more than one file to a new translation. They queue up and run side by side, and each shows its own status.

items.title: Live progress.
items.body: Playground jobs update on screen as they run, without a refresh.

items.title: **Go to Process**
items.body: on each Playground tool opens the process list already filtered to that tool's runs.
The react-1 lip-sync model is no longer offered. It is limited to 15 seconds of audio.

items.title: Prompts and memories keep their history.
items.body: They open in a full-page editor. Every save is a new version, and **Set as active version** brings back an earlier one without editing. Each shows who created it.

items.title: Translate your creations.
items.body: Select images in Quick Create or a collection and send them straight to Image Translation.

items.title: Vocals are always separated with AudioShake.
items.body: The Demucs option is gone from **Provider Preferences**.

items.title: New names in the nav rail.
items.body: Dashboard is now **Home**, and Translation Memory is now **TMS**. Pages and links work as before.

items.title: Running out of credits in the video editor showed a generic error.
items.body: Every editor action now explains the shortfall, and the export panel reports it for the whole batch.

items.title: Progress at the voice review step was wrong.
items.body: Transcription is now marked done when the review opens, and steps that run after the review keep their real status.

items.title: The memory picker showed no memories.
items.body: The dialog for linking to a translation memory now lists your memories.

items.title: Re-importing a term base created duplicate concepts.
items.body: Existing concepts are now matched instead of added again.

items.title: Re-importing TM segments could wipe their metadata.
items.body: A segment keeps its stored metadata when the file leaves it out.
